description: Check which recipients this inbox may send to, before preparing a send. Only the human can change these rules, in Account > Sending rules; do not send through another inbox to get around them.
name: get_sending_policy

addresses.description: Allowed addresses, matched exactly: in the local part, case, plus tags and dots all count; domain case does not. Every To, Cc and Bcc recipient must match an allowed address or domain.

domains.description: Allowed domains, ASCII and lowercased, matched exactly; a subdomain needs its own entry.

enabled.description: false: any recipient is allowed. true with no addresses or domains: all sending is blocked.

title: Get sending rules
